annotations.title: Request a taste, smell & touch check

description: Request that a human tastes, smells, touches or listens to a physical product and reports what it is actually like against your questions. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 49 for one tester plus product cost; EUR 29 per additional tester.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

how_to_obtain.description: How we get the product (purchase cost is itemised in our quote).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
